title: Build a Weather Station
description: A weather station measures temperature and needs to push updates to any number of displays. Instead of the station knowing about each display directly, observers register themselves and get notified automatically when the temperature changes.
hints: WeatherStation needs a List<Observer> to track who is registered
addObserver() adds to the list, removeObserver() removes from it
In setTemperature(), loop through the list and call o.update(temp) for each observer
issues: The station has no way to notify displays when temperature changes
Displays have no way to register interest in temperature updates
overallGoal: Implement the Observer pattern so WeatherStation can push temperature updates to any number of TemperatureDisplay observers without knowing about them directly.
goals: Add a List<Observer> to WeatherStation and implement addObserver() and removeObserver()
In setTemperature(), notify every registered observer by calling o.update(temp)
Implement TemperatureDisplay to record each update and expose getLatest() and getReadingCount()
